name: Push-up
steps: Place hands just outside shoulder width with legs extended and toes on the floor.
Brace the trunk so head, hips and heels form one line.
Bend elbows and lower the chest between the hands.
Press back to the starting position, letting the shoulder blades move around the ribs.
cues: Keep elbows angled back from the torso.
mistakes: Reaching the chin forward instead of lowering the chest.
breathing: Inhale while lowering; exhale while pressing up.
